On Wed, Apr 12, 2017 at 3:34 PM Sami Kallinen <notjust...@gmail.com> wrote:
hi, getting this error when i try to deploy to shinyapps.io, works locally:

Warning in FUN(X[[i]], ...) :
  Package 'data.frame' not available in repository or locally
Error: Unable to retrieve package records for the following packages:
- 'data.frame'

using following packages in the app:
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggthemes)

any ideas?

/s
